artifactNotice: Earlier downloadable prototypes, lessons and test results are conversation artifacts, not repository contents or CI results. This manifest does not import or reproduce them.
idNotice: Canonical proposed lesson IDs below supersede inconsistent prototype labels; no persisted learner records are migrated.

lessons.title: Authorization and computer readiness
acceptance: Define authorized boundaries and stop conditions
Record non-sensitive platform and resource inventory
Validate supported configurations rather than invent universal minimums

lessons.title: Host virtualization installation
acceptance: Choose and document the supported platform route
Review official downloads and licensing
Test installation, host compatibility and recovery

lessons.title: Prepare the offline learner workstation
acceptance: Verify official image and authenticity procedure
Inspect all adapters before boot
Change default credentials without collecting secrets
Demonstrate baseline recovery on supported hardware

lessons.title: Build the two-VM internal practice network
acceptance: Prepare a second clean peer with distinct identity and MAC
Validate topology, addresses and no unintended egress
Test bounded peer connectivity and controlled fault recovery
Do not treat a failed ping as isolation proof

lessons.title: Observe HTTP on the authorized clean peer
acceptance: Review and provision the helper without changing isolation
Explain listener, GET, HEAD, headers and body
Distinguish HTTP errors from transport observations
Execute the complete two-VM exercise before release

lessons.title: Evidence interpretation and professional reporting
acceptance: Separate observed facts, interpretations and uncertainty
Label fictional transcripts instead of claiming execution
Review independent work under a calibrated rubric
Enforce instructor-guide access and evidence privacy

releaseBlockers: Final workspace architecture and identity replacement
Trusted authorization adapters and private state persistence
Complete host and guest setup instructions
Supported versions, resources and original screenshots
Offline helper provisioning and licensing review
Repository code review and executed integration tests
authorizationRule: Page views, evidence submission and readiness review never automatically grant enrolment, course assignment, restricted-lab access or a formal award.
